name: RUNNING FROM THE INTERNET!
desc:
Run, fight, and defeat Nextbots with your friends in this fast-paced, chaotic arena for survival.

🌸 THE SAKURA UPDATE - New map named Sakura, new Inferno Blade item, Manhunt gamemode, a revamped shop with Daily/Weekly refreshes, and Kill Effects are here! Check out the changelog in-game to see everything new! 🎉

[SHIFT / CTRL] - Slide
[E] - Interact
[G] - Emote
All keybinds are modifiable in game!

🎲 Unbox dice blocks!
💥 Get unique items!
💣 Fight the Nextbots and other players!
🥇 Rank on the leaderboards!
🪙 Collect coins and buy better items!

❗Check the events tab under the game to be notified of latest updates❗
